source: GCP Cloud Billing public SKU catalog, on-demand

accounting.real: One concrete VM generation is counted once using its billable compute clock and disk lifetime. Stop pauses compute, not disk charges. Missing tariffs produce incomplete status and a null total.
accounting.basis: Lifecycle estimate, not a provider invoice. Marginal list rates; no automatic free-tier or discount credits.
accounting.hpc: No PlaFRIM monetary tariff was supplied; the cloud estimate does not assign a monetary cost to HPC allocation.
accounting.simulation: The simulation task/window cost and the plan lifecycle cost currently use different retention windows; report both without treating them as equivalent to a provider invoice.
